title: New insights into the structure and dynamics of the epigenetic modifications on DNA
content:
RSC Chem. Biol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5CB00207A, Paper
Open Access

Dineshbabu Takkella, Javier Cerezo, Lara Martinez-Fernandez, Krishna Gavvala
2-Aminopurine fluorescence and simulations show that epigenetic modifications tune DNA structure and dynamics, with methylcytosine stabilizing stacking and hydroxymethylcytosine inducing flexible, less stacked conformations.
